fields.description: Global save-file identifier magic; must equal the expected word or the boot load path flags the save invalid.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803560c reads 8 bytes at EEPROM offset 0 via FUN_080354a4 and accepts the header only if iStack_14 == *DAT_0803567c (expected magic supplied by FUN_0801e998 from DAT_0801e9e8); FUN_080356b4 writes it from DAT_08035744. Baseline logical u32@0 = 0xDEADBEEF.
fields.name: file_magic

fields.description: Reserved zero tag of the global header; the load path requires this word to be exactly zero.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803560c requires sStack_10 == 0 (logical bytes 4..5) before accepting the header; FUN_080356b4 always writes uStack_28 = 0. Baseline logical u16@4 = 0.
fields.name: file_reserved_zero

fields.description: Number of mirrored 8-byte slot records that follow the global header; drives the FUN_080356b4 write loop and the record stride (total/count).
fields.evidence: FUN_080356b4 stores param_1 into header bytes 6..7 (uStack_26) and writes that many records; FUN_0803528c (slot-header check shared with this layout) rejects values above 2 (uStack_a = 3 failure path). FUN_0801e998 calls FUN_080356b4(2). Baseline logical u16@6 = 2.
fields.name: file_record_count

fields.description: Per-slot header magic for slot 0; validated against the expected word on every boot and rewritten by the save routine.
fields.evidence: FUN_080356b4 writes DAT_0803574c to each record (first at EEPROM offset 8); FUN_080351b0 builds the slot-0 descriptor (read offset 8) and FUN_0803528c via FUN_0801ea50/FUN_0801e998 requires iStack_10 == *DAT_080352c4. Baseline logical u32@8 = 0xCAFEF00D.
fields.name: slot0_magic

fields.description: Reserved zero word of the slot-0 header; must read back as zero under the shared header check.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803528c requires sStack_c == 0 (slot-header bytes 4..5) for the FUN_080351b0 slot-0 descriptor; FUN_080356b4 always writes uStack_20 = 0 for records. Baseline logical u16@12 = 0.
fields.name: slot0_reserved_zero

fields.description: Slot-0 header parameter word; shares the <=2 validity rule of the 8-byte header layout.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803528c rejects slot-header third words above 2 (2 < uStack_a failure path) for descriptors built by FUN_080351b0 and checked from FUN_0801ea50. Baseline logical u16@14 = 0.
fields.name: slot0_param

fields.description: Per-slot header magic for slot 1; redundant mirror of slot0_magic written by the same loop.
fields.evidence: FUN_080356b4 record loop writes identical DAT_0803574c content to the record at stride offset 0x1000 (second iteration, sVar2 = 8 + sVar1*8); FUN_080351b0 slot-1 descriptor covers it. Baseline logical u32@0x1000 = 0xCAFEF00D, byte-identical to slot 0.
fields.name: slot1_magic

fields.description: Reserved zero word of the slot-1 header; mirror of slot0_reserved_zero.
fields.evidence: Same FUN_080356b4 record body (uStack_20 = 0) as slot 0; same shared check shape in FUN_0803528c. Baseline logical u16@0x1002 = 0.
fields.name: slot1_reserved_zero

fields.description: Slot-1 header parameter word; mirror of slot0_param under the same <=2 rule.
fields.evidence: FUN_080351b0 slot-1 descriptor + FUN_0803528c shared <=2 check via FUN_0801ea50; written 0 by the FUN_080356b4 loop. Baseline logical u16@0x1004 = 0.
fields.name: slot1_param
